subject:

content:
On 01/10/2024 02:24, Gax-c wrote:
> A devm_kzalloc() in asoc_qcom_lpass_cpu_platform_probe() could possibly return NULL pointer.
> NULL Pointer Dereference may be triggerred without addtional check.
